senses.gloss: f. (<he>אסי</he> = <cite ref="P01040"><he>עסי</he></cite>, <cite ref="P01049"><he>עסס</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="D00242"><he>דּוּךְ</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M00266"><he>מְדֹכָה</he></cite>)

units: Sabb. 77ᵇ (playful etym.) א׳ חסירתא ed. a. Var. Ar., it is called ăsitha because it is caved out (Ms. M. a. Ar. חסידתא pious, submitting to blows).
<cite ref="Chullin 105b:8">Ḥull. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ ובוכנא דתבלי</he> mortar and pestle for spices.
<cite ref="Niddah 36b:73">Nidd. 36ᵇ</cite> (Issi playing on his name) I am <he>א׳ דנחשא</he> a brazen mortar.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 49b:5">Keth. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>כפו ליה א׳ וכ׳</he> invert for him a mortar in public (improvise a stand) and let him stand up &c.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22b:21">M. Kat. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>כפי א׳</he> invert thou a mortar &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 52a:14">Ḥull. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>בוכנא וא׳</he> the pestle and the mortar, i.e. the rib sitting in the hip-bone and the hip-bone.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>שבוק הדא א׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A02316"><he>אנתתא</he></cite>, <he>איתתא בישא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665">Yalk. Lev. 665</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite> <he>איתתא</he>) divorce that mean woman.
